identifiers.statement: Capture night 2026-11-17 (scheduled capture; 1775 receipts new to the release), built in hosted run folder 44087092120-3 by the live release's own model definition, entity digests, producer versions and job pins (ct-pz32). It did not approve itself because 1 page(s) captured again at the same address changed bytes, which the link rule leaves to a named correction, and because the night is larger than the tripwires allow: links first seen on the 1,571 pages captured tonight (4.1 a page), queued and not yet fetched; the queue: 1,739 addresses fetched (the request budget), each counted once per attempt column, plus the newly queued links; listing rows of the re-captured pages: link text and listed-on for 4,796 rows, counted in two columns, and 738 new addresses; six person keys re-keyed; the comparison verified each successor, and person_aliases publishes the seven retired keys; one person key the new appearances make ambiguous; person_aliases states it, so the key resolves to a notice, not to nothing; one recording match replaced as 117 matches were added and 119 re-sourced from the night's meeting and video receipts.
identifiers.decision: ct-pz32, owner decision 2026-11-17; ct-4nax named corrections
